language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon starts on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around the handle and lifts the spoon (frames 95–123, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it toward the open drawer (frames 150–213, image and wrist_image). It lowers and releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 214–223; the spoon remains inside with the gripper withdrawn through frame 230 (image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unintended object displacement is visibly established.
